icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.all-dom.note: Filter option that shows animations for every Home Assistant domain (the entity type, such as light or switch).

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.domain.note: Label of the filter for the Home Assistant domain, the entity type such as light, switch or climate. Not an internet domain.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.glow.note: Name of an animation style: the animation with lit parts coloured and a soft halo. Pairs with Living and Quiet. A noun.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.glow-th.text: Glow: the full animation with its lit parts in the animation's colour, else the theme's, and a soft halo on dark cards.
icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.glow-th.note: Tooltip that describes the Glow style. Starts with the style name, which should match the translation of Glow.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.icon-li.note: Name of the collection of ready-made animated icons that ships with the card. Used as a heading or tab.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.living.note: Name of an animation style: the full animation as drawn. Pairs with Glow and Quiet. An adjective, as in a living icon.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.living-.text: Living: the full animation, as drawn.
icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.living-.note: Tooltip that describes the Living style. Starts with the style name, which should match the translation of Living.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.my-anim.note: Heading for one animation the user made themselves. Singular. Compare My animations.
Heading for the list of animations the user made themselves. Plural. Compare My animation.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.new-in-.note: Hidden label of the small diamond on an icon library tile that was added in this release; screen readers read it as part of the tile name.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.no-icon.note: Empty search result. {query} is the text the user typed in the search field.

vars.query: The value that replaces query in the text.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.no-libr.text: No library animation matches {icon}; showing all of them.
icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.no-libr.note: Notice above the grid. {icon} is the name of the icon in use, for example mdi:lightbulb. Keep it as is.

vars.icon: The value that replaces icon in the text.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.no-libr.text: No library animation matches {icon} or {domain}; showing all of them.
icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.no-libr.note: Notice above the grid. {icon} is the name of the icon in use, for example mdi:lightbulb. {domain} is the entity's Home Assistant domain, for example light. Keep both as is.

vars.domain: The value that replaces domain in the text.
vars.icon: The value that replaces icon in the text.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.quiet.note: Name of an animation style: a calm version where one part moves a little. Pairs with Glow and Living. An adjective.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.quiet-o.text: Quiet: one part moves a little, slower. For calm dashboards.
icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.quiet-o.note: Tooltip that describes the Quiet style. Starts with the style name, which should match the translation of Quiet.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.search-.note: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field in the animation grid. Search is a verb.
Placeholder of a shorter search field for icons. Search is a verb. Compare Search animated icons.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.show-al.note: Button that removes the filter and lists every animation. {count} is the total number of animations.

vars.count: The value that replaces count in the text.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.show-ma.note: Button that narrows the list back to animations that fit the current icon. Opposite of Show all.

icon-animator.animated-icon-grid.style.note: Label of the choice between the Glow, Living and Quiet looks of an animation.

icon-animator.follow-icon.animated-drawi.note: Fallback name of an animated icon that has no name of its own, when it was drawn by the user.

icon-animator.follow-icon.animated-name.note: Name given to an animated icon made from an existing icon. {name} is the icon's name, such as lightbulb.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

icon-animator.follow-icon.count-removed-.text: {count, plural, one {# part animation was} other {# part animations were}} removed because the new icon has fewer parts.
icon-animator.follow-icon.count-removed-.note: Notice after the user picked a different icon. {count} is how many per-part animations were removed. A part is a separately animated piece of the icon.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

icon-animator.follow-icon.part-n.note: Label of one separately animated piece of an icon. {n} is its number, starting at 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

icon-animator.follow-icon.the-animated-i.text: The animated icon was removed because the module's icon changed.
icon-animator.follow-icon.the-animated-i.note: Notice after the user changed the icon of a module that had an animated icon. A module is one element of the card.

icon-animator.follow-icon.the-icon-anima.text: The icon animation now uses the new icon ({icon}).
icon-animator.follow-icon.the-icon-anima.note: Notice after the user changed the icon. {icon} is the name of the new icon, for example mdi:lightbulb. Keep it as is.

vars.icon: The value that replaces icon in the text.

icon-animator.style.glow-halo.note: Label of the switch that adds a soft glow around a lit icon. A halo is a ring of light.
